caption.SceneDescription: The video captures a forward-tracking shot along a paved two-lane road winding through a lush green valley in the Swiss Alps. On the left, a steep, rocky mountain face rises sharply, dotted with evergreen trees and a thin waterfall cascading down the cliff. On the right, traditional wooden barns and houses sit amidst vibrant green pastures. A blue car approaches and passes in the opposite lane early in the clip. The sky is bright with scattered clouds, and the lighting is natural and even, highlighting the vivid greens of the grass and the grey tones of the mountains. The camera moves steadily forward, following the curve of the road.

editmeta.edit_instruction_1: Change the lighting in the scene to abruptly darken, shifting from bright daylight to a gloomy, overcast atmosphere with heavy, dark grey clouds filling the sky, turning the overall color palette cool and desaturated, and casting deep shadows across the valley and road.
editmeta.edit_instruction_2: Add a bright yellow vintage bus driving toward the camera along the darkened alpine road, with warm headlights cutting through the gloomy valley and reflecting on the asphalt while preserving the heavy storm clouds.
